title: Rick Doty sent to collect the witnesses' medical records
place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base flight surgeon's office, South Dakota

tellings.quote: he was brought in to go over sent over to the flight surgeon's office to pick up our medical records

plain: Mario Woods, a former guard at an American nuclear missile base, says he and his fellow guards were taken by something unexplained in 1977 near Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota. He says a man named Rick Doty was later sent to the flight surgeon's office, the base doctor's office, to pick up the guards' medical records, according to what Doty and another man, Michael Johnson, told him. If true, it would mean someone official took a quiet interest in what happened to them.
